$comment: Pull requests of the MS2 remediation, generated from the local commit stack. Author and reviewer are the planned assignments; review record, issues and merge date are filled from GitHub once the pull requests exist (tools/record-pull-requests.mjs). Sizes exclude dist/ and package-lock.json. inRemediationPlan=false marks pull requests added after the plan of 30 October. Pull requests marked implementsRequirements=false change every file (formatting, headers) and are not mapped to requirements in the matrix. Commit hashes are not recorded because the commits are re-created under the author's identity before they are pushed.
